use bytes::Bytes;
use onc_rpc_xdr::{XdrDecode, XdrEncode};

pub const NFS3_FHSIZE: i64 = 64;

pub const NFS3_WRITEVERFSIZE: i64 = 8;

pub type uint32 = u32;

pub type uint64 = u64;

pub type fileid3 = uint64;

pub type uid3 = uint32;

pub type gid3 = uint32;

pub type size3 = uint64;

pub type offset3 = uint64;

pub type mode3 = uint32;

pub type count3 = uint32;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct nfs_fh3 {
    pub data: Bytes,
}

impl XdrEncode for nfs_fh3 {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.data.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for nfs_fh3 {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            data: bytes::Bytes::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for nfs_fh3 {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        output.opaque(&self.data, Some(NFS3_FHSIZE as usize))?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub type writeverf3 = [u8; NFS3_WRITEVERFSIZE as usize];

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(i32)]
pub enum nfsstat3 {
    NFS3_OK = 0,
    NFS3ERR_PERM = 1,
    NFS3ERR_NOENT = 2,
    NFS3ERR_IO = 5,
    NFS3ERR_NXIO = 6,
    NFS3ERR_ACCES = 13,
    NFS3ERR_EXIST = 17,
    NFS3ERR_XDEV = 18,
    NFS3ERR_NODEV = 19,
    NFS3ERR_NOTDIR = 20,
    NFS3ERR_ISDIR = 21,
    NFS3ERR_INVAL = 22,
    NFS3ERR_FBIG = 27,
    NFS3ERR_NOSPC = 28,
    NFS3ERR_ROFS = 30,
    NFS3ERR_MLINK = 31,
    NFS3ERR_NAMETOOLONG = 63,
    NFS3ERR_NOTEMPTY = 66,
    NFS3ERR_DQUOT = 69,
    NFS3ERR_STALE = 70,
    NFS3ERR_REMOTE = 71,
    NFS3ERR_BADHANDLE = 10001,
    NFS3ERR_NOT_SYNC = 10002,
    NFS3ERR_BAD_COOKIE = 10003,
    NFS3ERR_NOTSUPP = 10004,
    NFS3ERR_TOOSMALL = 10005,
    NFS3ERR_SERVERFAULT = 10006,
    NFS3ERR_BADTYPE = 10007,
    NFS3ERR_JUKEBOX = 10008,
}

impl XdrEncode for nfsstat3 {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        (*self as i32).encode_xdr(output)
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for nfsstat3 {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match i32::decode_xdr(input)? {
            0 => Ok(Self::NFS3_OK),
            1 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_PERM),
            2 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NOENT),
            5 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_IO),
            6 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NXIO),
            13 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_ACCES),
            17 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_EXIST),
            18 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_XDEV),
            19 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NODEV),
            20 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NOTDIR),
            21 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_ISDIR),
            22 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_INVAL),
            27 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_FBIG),
            28 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NOSPC),
            30 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_ROFS),
            31 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_MLINK),
            63 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NAMETOOLONG),
            66 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NOTEMPTY),
            69 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_DQUOT),
            70 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_STALE),
            71 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_REMOTE),
            10001 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_BADHANDLE),
            10002 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NOT_SYNC),
            10003 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_BAD_COOKIE),
            10004 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_NOTSUPP),
            10005 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_TOOSMALL),
            10006 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_SERVERFAULT),
            10007 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_BADTYPE),
            10008 => Ok(Self::NFS3ERR_JUKEBOX),
            other => Err(onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError::InvalidEnum(other)),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for nfsstat3 {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        output.encode(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(i32)]
pub enum ftype3 {
    NF3REG = 1,
    NF3DIR = 2,
    NF3BLK = 3,
    NF3CHR = 4,
    NF3LNK = 5,
    NF3SOCK = 6,
    NF3FIFO = 7,
}

impl XdrEncode for ftype3 {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        (*self as i32).encode_xdr(output)
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for ftype3 {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match i32::decode_xdr(input)? {
            1 => Ok(Self::NF3REG),
            2 => Ok(Self::NF3DIR),
            3 => Ok(Self::NF3BLK),
            4 => Ok(Self::NF3CHR),
            5 => Ok(Self::NF3LNK),
            6 => Ok(Self::NF3SOCK),
            7 => Ok(Self::NF3FIFO),
            other => Err(onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError::InvalidEnum(other)),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for ftype3 {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        output.encode(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct specdata3 {
    pub specdata1: uint32,
    pub specdata2: uint32,
}

impl XdrEncode for specdata3 {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.specdata1.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.specdata2.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for specdata3 {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            specdata1: <uint32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            specdata2: <uint32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for specdata3 {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.specdata1, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.specdata2, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

        self.nseconds.encode_xdr(output)?;

        Ok(Self {
            seconds: <uint32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            nseconds: <uint32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.seconds, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.nseconds, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct fattr3 {
    pub r#type: ftype3,
    pub mode: mode3,
    pub nlink: uint32,
    pub uid: uid3,
    pub gid: gid3,
    pub size: size3,
    pub used: size3,
    pub rdev: specdata3,
    pub fsid: uint64,
    pub fileid: fileid3,
    pub atime: nfstime3,
    pub mtime: nfstime3,
    pub ctime: nfstime3,
}

impl XdrEncode for fattr3 {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.r#type.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.mode.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.nlink.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.uid.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.gid.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.size.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.used.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.rdev.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.fsid.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.fileid.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.atime.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.mtime.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.ctime.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for fattr3 {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            r#type: <ftype3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            mode: <mode3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            nlink: <uint32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            uid: <uid3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            gid: <gid3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            size: <size3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            used: <size3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            rdev: <specdata3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            fsid: <uint64 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            fileid: <fileid3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            atime: <nfstime3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            mtime: <nfstime3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            ctime: <nfstime3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for fattr3 {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.r#type, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.mode, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.nlink, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.uid, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.gid, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.size, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.used, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.rdev, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.fsid, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.fileid, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.atime, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.mtime, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.ctime, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum post_op_attr {
    True {
        attributes: fattr3,
    },
    False,
}

impl XdrEncode for post_op_attr {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::True { attributes } => {
                (true).encode_xdr(output)?;
                attributes.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::False => {
                (false).encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for post_op_attr {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        let discriminant = <bool as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?;
        match discriminant {
            true => Ok(Self::True { attributes: <fattr3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            false => Ok(Self::False),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for post_op_attr {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::True { attributes } => {
                output.encode(&(true))?;
                onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&attributes, output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::False => {
                output.encode(&(false))?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

            size: <size3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,

        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.size, output)?;

        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.ctime, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

    True {
        attributes: wcc_attr,

    False,
}

impl XdrEncode for pre_op_attr {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::True { attributes } => {
                (true).encode_xdr(output)?;
                attributes.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::False => {
                (false).encode_xdr(output)?;

        }
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for pre_op_attr {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        let discriminant = <bool as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?;
        match discriminant {
            true => Ok(Self::True { attributes: <wcc_attr as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            false => Ok(Self::False),

    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::True { attributes } => {
                output.encode(&(true))?;

                Ok(())
            }
            Self::False => {
                output.encode(&(false))?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct wcc_data {
    pub before: pre_op_attr,
    pub after: post_op_attr,
}

impl XdrEncode for wcc_data {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.before.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.after.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for wcc_data {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            before: <pre_op_attr as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            after: <post_op_attr as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for wcc_data {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.before, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.after, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct READ3args {
    pub file: nfs_fh3,
    pub offset: offset3,
    pub count: count3,
}

impl XdrEncode for READ3args {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.file.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.offset.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.count.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for READ3args {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            file: <nfs_fh3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            offset: <offset3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            count: <count3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for READ3args {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.file, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.offset, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.count, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct READ3resok {
    pub file_attributes: post_op_attr,
    pub count: count3,
    pub eof: bool,
    pub data: Bytes,
}

impl XdrEncode for READ3resok {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.file_attributes.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.count.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.eof.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.data.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for READ3resok {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            file_attributes: <post_op_attr as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            count: <count3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            eof: <bool as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            data: bytes::Bytes::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for READ3resok {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.file_attributes, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.count, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.eof, output)?;
        output.opaque(&self.data, None)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct READ3resfail {
    pub file_attributes: post_op_attr,
}

impl XdrEncode for READ3resfail {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.file_attributes.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for READ3resfail {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            file_attributes: <post_op_attr as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for READ3resfail {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.file_attributes, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum READ3res {
    Nfs3Ok {
        resok: READ3resok,
    },
    Default {
        discriminant: i32,
        resfail: READ3resfail,
    },
}

impl XdrEncode for READ3res {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::Nfs3Ok { resok } => {
                (nfsstat3::NFS3_OK).encode_xdr(output)?;
                resok.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::Default { discriminant, resfail } => {
                discriminant.encode_xdr(output)?;
                resfail.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for READ3res {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        let discriminant = <i32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?;
        match discriminant {
            value if value == nfsstat3::NFS3_OK as i32 => Ok(Self::Nfs3Ok { resok: <READ3resok as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            discriminant => Ok(Self::Default { discriminant, resfail: <READ3resfail as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for READ3res {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::Nfs3Ok { resok } => {
                output.encode(&(nfsstat3::NFS3_OK))?;
                onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&resok, output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::Default { discriminant, resfail } => {
                output.encode(discriminant)?;
                onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&resfail, output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(i32)]
pub enum stable_how {
    UNSTABLE = 0,
    DATA_SYNC = 1,
    FILE_SYNC = 2,
}

impl XdrEncode for stable_how {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        (*self as i32).encode_xdr(output)
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for stable_how {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match i32::decode_xdr(input)? {
            0 => Ok(Self::UNSTABLE),
            1 => Ok(Self::DATA_SYNC),
            2 => Ok(Self::FILE_SYNC),
            other => Err(onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError::InvalidEnum(other)),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for stable_how {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        output.encode(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct WRITE3args {
    pub file: nfs_fh3,
    pub offset: offset3,
    pub count: count3,
    pub stable: stable_how,
    pub data: Bytes,
}

impl XdrEncode for WRITE3args {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.file.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.offset.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.count.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.stable.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.data.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for WRITE3args {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            file: <nfs_fh3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            offset: <offset3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            count: <count3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            stable: <stable_how as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            data: bytes::Bytes::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for WRITE3args {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.file, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.offset, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.count, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.stable, output)?;
        output.opaque(&self.data, None)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct WRITE3resok {
    pub file_wcc: wcc_data,

        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.file_wcc, output)?;

        Ok(())
    }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct WRITE3resfail {
    pub file_wcc: wcc_data,
}

impl XdrEncode for WRITE3resfail {

        Ok(())
    }

            file_wcc: <wcc_data as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for WRITE3resfail {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.file_wcc, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum WRITE3res {
    Nfs3Ok {
        resok: WRITE3resok,
    },
    Default {
        discriminant: i32,
        resfail: WRITE3resfail,
    },
}

impl XdrEncode for WRITE3res {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::Nfs3Ok { resok } => {
                (nfsstat3::NFS3_OK).encode_xdr(output)?;
                resok.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::Default { discriminant, resfail } => {
                discriminant.encode_xdr(output)?;
                resfail.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for WRITE3res {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        let discriminant = <i32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?;
        match discriminant {
            value if value == nfsstat3::NFS3_OK as i32 => Ok(Self::Nfs3Ok { resok: <WRITE3resok as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            discriminant => Ok(Self::Default { discriminant, resfail: <WRITE3resfail as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for WRITE3res {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::Nfs3Ok { resok } => {
                output.encode(&(nfsstat3::NFS3_OK))?;
                onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&resok, output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::Default { discriminant, resfail } => {
                output.encode(discriminant)?;
                onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&resfail, output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

pub mod nfs_program {
    pub const PROGRAM: u32 = 100003;

    pub mod nfs_v3 {
        pub const VERSION: u32 = 3;
        pub const NFSPROC3_READ: u32 = 6;
        pub const NFSPROC3_WRITE: u32 = 7;
        pub const NFSPROC3_COMMIT: u32 = 21;
    }

}

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct nfs_fh3Metadata {
    pub data: onc_rpc_xdr::OpaqueLength<{ NFS3_FHSIZE as usize }>,
}

impl XdrDecode for nfs_fh3Metadata {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            data: <onc_rpc_xdr::OpaqueLength<{ NFS3_FHSIZE as usize }> as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata for nfs_fh3Metadata {
    const MAX_PREFIX_BYTES: usize = 4;
    fn opaque_len(&self) -> Option<usize> { onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata::opaque_len(&self.data) }
}

}

            count: <count3 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            eof: <bool as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,

        })
    }
}

    const MAX_PREFIX_BYTES: usize = 100;
    fn opaque_len(&self) -> Option<usize> { onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata::opaque_len(&self.data) }
}

}

        count: value.count,
        stable: value.stable,
        data: value.data.into(),
    } }
}
